# odinex_placement_group (Resource)

Manages a placement group (servers of a `spread` group run on different hosts).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_placement_group" "spread" {
  name     = "spread"
  location = "fra1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location of the placement group, e.g. `fra1`.
- `name` (String) Name of the placement group.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Up to 64 pairs; keys and values up to 63 characters.
- `type` (String) Type of the placement group. Only `spread` is supported.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.
- `servers` (Set of Number) IDs of the servers in the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import odinex_placement_group.spread 2
```
